d: Who are the Nihang Sikhs, and why do they frequently make headlines? Tracing their roots to Guru Gobind Singh and the creation of the Khalsa in 1699, this video of Tarikh explores the history, lifestyle, and military traditions of the Akali Nihangs. From fearless warrior battalions led by Baba Deep Singh to penalizing Maharaja Ranjit Singh at Akal Takht under Akali Phula Singh, uncover their unique code of conduct. Explore the truth behind their secret deras, traditional weaponry, Baba Budha Dal, and why this revered order faces modern controversies, including clashes and the recent…
